title: State Preschool Program contracts for 2025-26
question: Which San Francisco agencies hold State Preschool contracts for 2025-26, and how do the sums compare with earlier years and with the places they are licensed for?
finding: The State lists 22 San Francisco preschool contracts worth $93.4 million for 2025-26, 2.1% of $4,386.0 million statewide; the San Francisco Unified School District holds $35.8 million. 22 of 23 amounts match the State figures already used in the child-care screens. The file also lists South San Francisco Unified School District ($1.4 million) under San Francisco County. Measured against open licensed places under the same name, the highest is Mission Child Care Consortium at $23,994 a place.
how: State Preschool Program 2025-26 funding results, rows with county San Francisco. Earlier years are the State figures already on disk. Places are the open centre licences in the State licensing file of 15 November 2026 whose licensee matches the agency name.
limits: A contract is a maximum the State will reimburse, not money paid. Preschool contracts also pay for part-day sessions, so one licensed place can serve two children a day. A school district's places may sit under licences in another name. A dropped agency may have merged, changed name or moved its contract.
